label: Switch to HDR for fullscreen HDR content
desc: Let fullscreen HDR apps switch the display mode automatically; leave this off if the panel blanks during the switch

label: Settings window size
desc: Fill the work area or use a custom centred size

label: Settings width
desc: Share of the monitor work area; never smaller than the Settings layout needs

label: Settings height
desc: Share of the monitor work area; never smaller than the Settings layout needs

label: Column width
desc: Share of the screen each column takes, scrolling layout only

label: Scroll to follow focus
desc: Keep the focused window in view as the strip scrolls

label: Preserve split
desc: Keep the split direction when windows close and reopen

label: Smart split
desc: Split toward the corner of the window the cursor is nearest

label: Smart resizing
desc: Resize toward the mouse instead of a fixed edge

label: Default split ratio
desc: Size a new split gives the new window, 1.0 is even

label: Force split side
desc: Where a new window lands: follow cursor or force a side

label: Split from active
desc: Split from the active window, not the one under the cursor

label: Master size
desc: Share of the screen the master window takes

label: New window role
desc: Whether a new window becomes master, a slave, or inherits

label: New on top
desc: Add a new stack window at the top, not the bottom

label: Master side
desc: Which side the master column sits on

label: Smart resizing
desc: Resize toward the mouse instead of a fixed edge

label: Window title bars
desc: Adds a bar with the window's title above it, applies on Save

label: Bar height
desc: Vertical space the title bar takes on each window

label: Title text size
desc: How big the window's name renders in the bar

label: Blur the bar
desc: The bar goes translucent and blurs whatever sits behind it

label: Close and maximise buttons
desc: Coloured dots on the bar: red closes, green goes fullscreen

label: Liquid glass windows
desc: Blur with glass-like refraction on windows, applies on Save

label: Preset
desc: Glass look, from nearly clear to heavy frosting

label: Blur strength
desc: How heavily the glass frosts what is behind the window

label: Glass opacity
desc: How visible the glass pane is over the window

label: Glass brightness
desc: Brightness of the glass effect

label: Glass theme
desc: Light or dark base for the glass tint

label: Glass tint
desc: Color washed over the glass

label: Image border around windows
desc: Tile a picture around each window as its frame

label: Border image
desc: The picture tiled around windows, takes effect on Save

label: Border scale
desc: Grows or shrinks the tiled picture around each window

label: Smooth scaling
desc: Filters the picture when scaled, off keeps hard pixel edges

label: Blur border image
desc: Blur what shows through a transparent border image

label: Border sizes
desc: Edge thicknesses as left,right,top,bottom in pixels

label: Border insets
desc: How far the image tucks under the window edges

label: Realistic cursor motion
desc: The pointer tilts, turns, or stretches as it moves

label: Style
desc: Which deformation the motion uses

label: Shake to find (magnify)
desc: Shake the mouse to briefly grow the pointer

label: Magnify on shake
desc: How much the cursor grows when you shake it to find it

label: Animate the focused window
desc: Brief effect on the window that takes focus

label: Style
desc: Flash dips opacity, Bounce springs, Slide nudges

label: Flash opacity
desc: Opacity the flash dips to, lower is deeper; Flash style only

label: Bounce strength
desc: Scale the window shrinks to; lower bounces harder

label: Slide height
desc: How far the window hops, in pixels; Slide style only

label: Keyboard sounds
desc: Play a sound on every key press, in every app

label: Sound profile
desc: Which switch you hear; import Mechvibes packs as profiles

label: Volume
desc: How loud the samples play, relative to how they were made

label: Key release sound
desc: Also play a softer sample when a key comes back up

label: Bezier curve P1 x (first control point, X)
desc: Time of the first handle, 0 to 1; eases the start

label: Bezier curve P1 y (first control point, Y)
desc: Progress at the first handle; below 0 pulls back first

label: Bezier curve P2 x (second control point, X)
desc: Time of the second handle, 0 to 1; eases the end

label: Bezier curve P2 y (second control point, Y)
desc: Progress at the second handle; above 1 overshoots

label: Saved curves
desc: Curves saved by name; animations using one follow it

label: New (add curve)
desc: Add a curve with a stock ease shape and edit it

label: Delete / Reset (curve)
desc: Delete a custom curve, or drop a built-in's override

label: Reset to defaults
desc: Clear every animation override and custom curve

desc: Spin the border gradient; can keep the GPU busy nonstop

label: Border gradient spin · speed
desc: Tenths of a second; 10 is one second, higher is slower

label: Border gradient spin · bezier curve
desc: Easing curve it follows; set it in the Curves section

desc: Tenths of a second; 10 is one second, higher is slower

desc: Easing curve it follows; set it in the Curves section

label: Window close fade · enabled

label: Window close fade · speed

desc: Tenths of a second; 10 is one second, higher is slower

label: Fades (group) · bezier curve
desc: Easing curve it follows; set it in the Curves section

label: Border color · speed
desc: Tenths of a second; 10 is one second, higher is slower

label: Border color · bezier curve
desc: Easing curve it follows; set it in the Curves section

desc: Tenths of a second; 10 is one second, higher is slower

desc: Easing curve it follows; set it in the Curves section

desc: Root of the tree; rows below still override it

label: All animations (root) · speed
desc: Tenths of a second; 10 is one second, higher is slower

label: All animations (root) · bezier curve
desc: Easing curve it follows; set it in the Curves section

label: Window close · enabled
desc: Motion when a window closes; off, windows vanish instantly

label: Window close · speed
desc: Tenths of a second; 10 is one second, higher is slower

label: Window close · bezier curve
desc: Easing curve it follows; set it in the Curves section

desc: Slide out, pop, or gnomed; Default leaves it to Hyprland

label: Shell layers · enabled

desc: Tenths of a second; 10 is one second, higher is slower

label: Shell layers · bezier curve
desc: Easing curve it follows; set it in the Curves section

label: Shell layers · style
desc: Slide, pop, or fade; Default leaves it to Hyprland

label: Window open fade · enabled
desc: Fade-in of opening windows; off, they appear at full opacity

label: Window open fade · speed
desc: Tenths of a second; 10 is one second, higher is slower

label: Window open fade · bezier curve
desc: Easing curve it follows; set it in the Curves section

label: Special workspace · enabled
desc: Motion when the scratchpad workspace shows or hides

label: Special workspace · speed
desc: Tenths of a second; 10 is one second, higher is slower

label: Special workspace · bezier curve
desc: Easing curve it follows; set it in the Curves section

label: Special workspace · style
desc: How the scratchpad slides or fades in and out

label: Windows (group) · enabled
desc: Open, close, and move as one; rows below override it

label: Windows (group) · speed
desc: Tenths of a second; 10 is one second, higher is slower

label: Windows (group) · bezier curve
desc: Easing curve it follows; set it in the Curves section

label: Windows (group) · style
desc: Slide in, pop, or gnomed; Default leaves it to Hyprland

label: Shell layer fade-in · enabled
desc: Fade shell surfaces in as they appear

label: Shell layer fade-in · speed
desc: Tenths of a second; 10 is one second, higher is slower

label: Shell layer fade-in · bezier curve
desc: Easing curve it follows; set it in the Curves section

label: Shell layer fade-out · enabled
desc: Fade shell surfaces out as they close

label: Shell layer fade-out · speed
desc: Tenths of a second; 10 is one second, higher is slower

label: Shell layer fade-out · bezier curve
desc: Easing curve it follows; set it in the Curves section

label: Window move · enabled
desc: Motion while windows are moved, dragged, or resized

label: Window move · speed
desc: Tenths of a second; 10 is one second, higher is slower

label: Window move · bezier curve
desc: Easing curve it follows; set it in the Curves section

label: Window move · style
desc: Slide, pop, or gnomed; Default leaves it to Hyprland

desc: Blur, dim, or restyle shell surfaces per namespace

desc: Layer-shell name to match, e.g. launcher; else no effect

desc: What the rule does; changing it resets the value

desc: Only Ignore alpha uses it: alpha cutoff 0.0 to 1.0

desc: Swipe, pinch, and long-press to drive windows and workspaces, applies on Save

desc: How far a finger must travel before a gesture counts; raise it on big tablets

desc: Pixels from the screen edge that start an edge swipe
